source.already_anonymized: Synthetic documents generated with Gretel Navigator; no real customer data

integrity.method: SHA256 per file equal to the manifest recorded at registration

scope: Independent public human annotations; semi-synthetic clinical and real public judicial corpora remain separate

taxonomy.exclusion_reason: These clinical attributes are outside the PHI/masking gold annotation task, so unlabeled medical spans cannot be asserted false positives

runs.cpu_accounting_note: Process CPU only; excludes child CPU

coverage_leakage.definition: Union of predicted spans, irrespective of predicted category; detection coverage only, not final transformed-output leakage. Entity values group by category and casefolded text, not verified personal identities.

metrics.review_rate_definition: candidate uncertainty proxy only; no transformation or semantic-model release gating evaluated
metrics.unavailable_metrics_reason: Text gold corpus does not include original page images or table geometry; rule scores are not calibrated

limitations: MEDDOCAN is not real private patient data and is predominantly Spain Spanish, not a Mexican enterprise holdout
TAB uses the first reviewed annotator, DIRECT/QUASI mask decisions and a different English judicial task
No corpus text, source filenames or entity values are in this report
Text corpora do not measure OCR/layout/table accuracy or real output-transformation leakage
Confidence intervals resample documents and do not account for source/provider template correlations
